{{Quote|The galactic powers lie to you! Wake up! The only truth lies with the Separatists!|FR3-D0M|<ref name="PriceOfFreedom" />}}
'''FR3-D0M''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was part of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] stationed on [[Kessan's Landing]], a small and forgotten island on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="PriceOfFreedom" /> FR3-D0M was reprogrammed by the Mantellian Separatists to spread their [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] and eliminate anyone who opposed them.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20231019|text=Game Update 7.4 "Chains in the Dark" Livestream recap}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
FR3-D0M appears in the [[2023]] Game Update 7.4 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' as a world boss found in Kessan's Landing, a daily area on Ord Mantell.<ref name="TORweb" />
